title: Dometic 30 oz Travel Tumbler, Ocean

writeup: Woot has the Dometic 30 oz Travel Tumbler in the Ocean color, new, for $19.99. Dometic's own site and Nomadic Supply both sell the exact same Ocean tumbler (MPN 97000071471) for $44.99, so you save about $25. It's copper-lined, double-wall vacuum insulated steel with a leakproof straw lid and a carry handle. Only three were left when we checked, with a limit of three per customer.
